'''Rebel heavy troopers''' were specialized heavy weapons experts in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]]. These [[Rebel trooper|soldiers]] were trained and equipped to counter and destroy even the most heavily armored vehicles of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="FIB" />
